violation_type.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §742.403((1)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has not responded to multiple attempts regarding liability insurance.

finding_variants.text: The operation has not responded to multiple attempts regarding liability insurance.
Operation has failed to submit verification of insurance.

This Standard was found to be out of compliance. Multiple correspondence were sent to the home to discuss the Liability Insurance Requirements, but no reply was given from the home. The home has also not updated their Provider Page with Liability Insurance information.
It was found the operation does  not have Liability Insurance.
Liability insurance has been expired since July 2025.
